title: Disclaimer
description: Important limitations of SecureKit's security estimates and tools.
body:
SecureKit provides estimates for educational and convenience purposes. A strong score does not mean a password is safe, and a missing breach match does not mean a password has never been exposed.

Crack-time results depend on hashing algorithms, hardware, rate limiting and attacker strategy. MD5 and SHA-1 are not suitable for password storage. Base64 is encoding, not encryption.

Never reuse passwords, use a password manager and enable multi-factor authentication.
note: This is general informational content and should be reviewed for your specific business and jurisdiction. It is not legal advice.
